verdict.rationale: Extend supports deployable, versioned workflows (extend-docs-43, extend-docs-66). These can be run via API or CLI (extend-docs-32, extend-docs-70), with asynchronous processing on every endpoint (extend-docs-37, extend-docs-67) and webhook subscriptions for workflow events (extend-docs-68). Together these let document pipelines run unattended once invoked, and confidence scores can auto-accept values while routing the rest to review (extend-docs-34). However, nothing shows workflows starting on their own without an external caller. Missing for 10: autonomous triggers such as schedules, watched inboxes or folders, or auto-ingestion; documentation of fully background, self-starting automations; independent hands-on corroboration.
